environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed in a hardened Kubernetes pod. Container spec includes securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true with NO tmpfs volumes or emptyDir mounts attached. Pod-level DNS configuration uses a custom dnsConfig with ndots:1 and a local caching resolver (node-local-dns) configured with serve_stale and a minimum TTL floor of 300s via the 'template' plugin rewrite. Additionally, a Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy is applied with DNS-aware egress rules that pin resolved IPs for the duration of a connection using toFQDNs with a 300s minimum DNS TTL cache, preventing the second resolution from returning a different IP than what was validated. The Cilium DNS proxy intercepts all DNS queries from the pod and caches results, meaning the HTTP client's re-resolution hits the same cached entry that was validated.
